use default
use Math = System.Math
use Raster.Anchor
use Raster.IMAGE

running_maxima(heights: Iterable[int]) -> Pipe[int] is
    let highest mut = 0

    for height in heights do
        highest = Math.max(highest, height)

        yield highest
    od
si

depths(heights: int[]) -> List[int] => (
    let left = running_maxima(heights) |> collect()
    let right =
        running_maxima(heights |> reverse()) |> collect()
    let last = heights.count - 1

    (0..heights.count)
    |> map(i => Math.min(left[i], right[last - i]) - heights[i])
    |> collect()
)

let series =
    [[1, 5, 3, 7, 2],
     [5, 3, 7, 2, 6, 4, 5, 9, 1, 2],
     [2, 6, 3, 5, 2, 8, 1, 4, 2, 2, 5, 3, 5, 7, 4, 1],
     [5, 5, 5, 5],
     [5, 6, 7, 8],
     [8, 7, 7, 6],
     [6, 7, 10, 7, 6]]

let gap = 2.5

let span =
    (series |> map(towers => cast double(towers.count) + gap)
            |> reduce(0.0, (total, width) => total + width)) - gap

let tallest =
    series
    |> flat_map(towers => towers |> pipe())
    |> max() ?? 0

let image = IMAGE(1000, 300)

image.view(
    -0.5, -4.0,
    span + 0.5, cast double(tallest) + 4.0,
    16.0)

box(left: double, bottom: double, right: double, top: double) is
    image.fill(
        [(x = left, y = bottom),
         (x = right, y = bottom),
         (x = right, y = top),
         (x = left, y = top)]
        |> collect_list())
si

let stone = (red = 110ub, green = 105ub, blue = 100ub)
let water = (red = 90ub, green = 160ub, blue = 220ub)

let ceiling = cast double(tallest)

image.colour(water)
box(0.0, ceiling + 1.8, 1.2, ceiling + 2.8)

image.colour(70ub, 70ub, 70ub)
image.text(2.0, ceiling + 2.0, 14.0, "water collected", Anchor.LEFT)

let at mut = 0.0

for towers in series do
    let depth = depths(towers)
    let volume = depth |> reduce(0, (total, units) => total + units)

    for column in 0..towers.count do
        let left = at + cast double(column)
        let height = cast double(towers[column])

        image.colour(stone)
        box(left, 0.0, left + 1.0, height)

        image.colour(water)
        box(left, height, left + 1.0,
            height + cast double(depth[column]))
    od

    image.colour(70ub, 70ub, 70ub)
    image.stroke(1.2)
    image.line(at, 0.0, at + cast double(towers.count), 0.0)

    image.text(at + cast double(towers.count) / 2.0, -2.4, 15.0,
               "{volume}", Anchor.CENTRE)

    at = at + cast double(towers.count) + gap
od

image.write("towers.png")

image.show("towers.png")
